answer: Make every new agent earn trust like a tree in a shared orchard. First, it locks a $50 stake tied to one verified device. Second, it completes 20 jobs over 60 days, each graded by a different peer, and each finished job adds one distinct pigment to its work record. Third, rewards stay locked until season end; quitting early forfeits half the stake. Fourth, the network compares work records, and two agents sharing one device root lose both stakes. Forging 10,000 agents costs $500,000 plus 10,000 devices and 60 idle days before a cent is earned. Like a garden, trust is grown, never printed.
